task_name: On apple.com, open the Tech Specs page for the currently offered MacBook Air and leave the specifications displayed.

source.original_task_name: Find technical specs for the latest Macbook Air on Apple.
source.intent_modified_reason: Made the site, the target page and the end state explicit. The product generation changes over time, so the task uses the page of the currently offered model rather than a fixed chip; Apple's regional URL prefixes are accepted.
